issues.description: SealSaloon is required (UML + text) to provide a method named checkOrderReady(), and orderMeal(...) should call checkOrderReady(). The solution instead implements the FIFO serving logic in a differently named method processOrders() and never defines checkOrderReady(), so an implementation following the spec (or tests calling checkOrderReady) will not match the provided solution/API.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename processOrders() to checkOrderReady() and update orderMeal(...) to call checkOrderReady(); alternatively, add a public checkOrderReady() method that delegates to processOrders() and change orderMeal(...) to call checkOrderReady() as specified.

issues.description: The Stock API in the UML lists only add(String), take(String), findStockIngredient(String), addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), and emptyStock(). However, both template and solution additionally expose a public setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]) method (used by Main) that is not specified. This creates an unclear public API surface for students (whether they are allowed/expected to use/implement this setter).
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the UML/spec to include setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]) explicitly as a permitted helper (e.g., for Main/testing), or remove it from the public API and adjust Main to populate stock using addToStockIngredients(...) or SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(...).
